    About Datapad

    Every ship, ship weapon, component, FPS weapon and armour piece in the current Star Citizen game files, with stats, pictures, in-game aUEC prices and where to buy. The data refreshes itself every fortnight.

    Add it to your home screen

    1. Open this page in your phone's browser (Safari on iPhone, Chrome on Android).
    2. Tap Share (iPhone) or the ⋮ menu (Android).
    3. Choose Add to Home Screen.

    It then opens straight from your home screen like an app. Your filters, stats layout and compare picks are remembered on that device.

    Where the data comes from

    Hull, shield, DPS and speed figures for ships are for the default loadout. QT range is the stock quantum drive on a full tank. Weapon damage and DPS are per the default fire mode with no attachments. Armour damage reduction applies to physical and energy damage. Component power and cooling figures are per the game's resource units.

    Sources: Star Citizen Wiki · Star Citizen Wiki API · UEX · scunpacked-data. Fan-made; not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.
